display_information.name: SolidPing
display_information.description: Uptime and incident alerts, right in your channels
display_information.long_description:
SolidPing watches your websites, APIs, servers and network services from multiple regions, and tells your team the moment something breaks — in the channel where they already are.

*In Slack you can:*
• Receive incident alerts, escalations and recovery notices in any channel
• Create a check without leaving Slack, with a slash command
• Acknowledge and resolve incidents from the message itself
• Sign in to the SolidPing dashboard with your Slack identity
• See live status inline when someone pastes a SolidPing link

SolidPing runs HTTP, ICMP, TCP, UDP, DNS, FTP and many other check types, with alerting by Slack, email, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, Discord and webhooks. It is open source and can be self-hosted, or used as a hosted service.

Free plan available. Pricing: https://www.solidping.io/pricing
